hidden-costs-of-rework.caption: Hidden costs of rework.
hidden-costs-of-rework.alt_text: Graphic illustrating the hidden costs of rework.
hidden-costs-of-rework.usage_notes: Confirm final attribution and publication rights before external release.

bottleneck-shift-map.caption: The bottleneck shift. When AI accelerates production, the constraint moves upstream to definition and downstream to verification. The constraint never disappears; it moves.
bottleneck-shift-map.alt_text: Two delivery pipelines compared: before AI, Build is the narrow constraint; after AI, Build is wide while Definition and Verification become the constraints.
bottleneck-shift-map.usage_notes: Constraint-movement framing follows Goldratt's Theory of Constraints; consider a name-check in surrounding prose.

framework-map-ai-era.caption: Six lenses and one posture. Each framework sees a real problem clearly, fails in a characteristic way when misused, and keeps a distinct job in the AI era.
framework-map-ai-era.alt_text: Table comparing Lean, Agile, Six Sigma, ITIL, PMBOK, BABOK, and the Sane posture by problem solved, what each sees clearly, failure mode, and AI-era role.
framework-map-ai-era.usage_notes: Framework names are trademarks of their respective stewards; used descriptively.

work-lifecycle-map.caption: The modern lifecycle of work. AI accelerates the marked stages; human judgment gates the diamonds. The learning loop back to need is the point.
work-lifecycle-map.alt_text: Flow of work through ten stages from Need to Learn, with dots marking AI-accelerated stages and diamonds marking human judgment gates, and a loop from Learn back to Need.

role-shift-map.caption: Roles are reweighted, not retired. Every role sheds routine work and gains judgment work; accountability never transfers to the machine.
role-shift-map.alt_text: Table showing how project manager, business analyst, developer, QA, architect, service owner, and AI agent roles shift: less routine work, more judgment work, with unchanged ownership.

governance-upstream.caption: Governance moves upstream. Judgment concentrated at release and operations arrives after momentum has made mistakes expensive; judgment placed at intent, context, and design is cheap.
governance-upstream.alt_text: Two timelines comparing where human review happens: bunched at release and operations versus distributed early at intent, context, and design.

audience-impact-matrix.caption: One decision, four audiences. The same change lands differently on customers, employees, field teams, and partners - and each is owed something specific.
audience-impact-matrix.alt_text: Matrix showing what changes, what is feared, and what leaders owe customers, employees, field teams, and partners when technology decisions land.

terminology-crosswalk.caption: Old words, new weights. Familiar delivery vocabulary survives the AI era, but what each word carries shifts.
terminology-crosswalk.alt_text: Table mapping familiar terms - requirements, code review, velocity, backlog, incident, governance - to what stays, what shifts, and what is genuinely new.

adoption-compression-timeline.caption: The adjustment cycle is compressing. Time for major technologies to reach 100 million users, from 75 years to 2 months.
adoption-compression-timeline.footer: Figures are popularized estimates; the point is the shape of the curve, not the decimals.
adoption-compression-timeline.reference: UBS analysis reported by Yahoo Finance (2023), 'ChatGPT on track to surpass 100 million monthly users faster than TikTok or Instagram'; app-era figures as compiled by Visual Capitalist (visualcapitalist.com/threads-100-million-users); earlier technologies from commonly cited adoption estimates.
adoption-compression-timeline.alt_text: Horizontal bar chart of time to reach 100 million users: Telephone 75 years, Mobile phone 16 years, World Wide Web 7 years, Facebook 4.5 years, Instagram 2.5 years, TikTok 9 months, ChatGPT 2 months.
adoption-compression-timeline.credit: Author-created visualization; data from public reporting
adoption-compression-timeline.usage_notes: Verify figures against a primary source before print; telephone and web estimates vary by methodology.
